fusions.name: Safety in Numbers
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Circling the Fold
fusions.desc: Slashes in a wide circle, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, your party's damage rises by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hidden in the Herd
fusions.desc: Veils you and your party for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Long Graze
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
